blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video diffusion transformers reuse key--value (KV) caches across denoising steps, which quickly becomes a bottleneck for long video generation. We find that quantizing temporally distant cache vectors leads to a large range and high quantization error, but that nearby video tokens in the KV-cache share a persistent pattern per channel. These patterns also vary across videos, motivating rotations that are adapted to each video's unique cache. We propose Temporal Rotation Quantization (TRQ), a method that rotates frames in the cache that are adjacent in time before quantization. For each block of temporally adjacent cache vectors, TRQ fits an orthogonal transform that maps the block's per-channel means to a vector that is close to a constant across channels. To keep the quantization format lightweight, we parameterize this rotation as a tree of $2 \times 2$ planar rotations, each stored with only two bits, followed by a fixed Hadamard transform shared across all blocks. The rotations are fit without gradients or changes to model weights, and we prove that a simple greedy fit is globally optimal for our 'mean-flattening' objective. The transforms are fit online for each new video, and we release fused Triton kernels to make this process efficient at inference. At 2-bit precision and matched compression, TRQ improves VBench subject consistency over the state-of-the-art method QVG from 90.38 to 92.02 on LongCat-Video-13B and from 86.33 to 87.61 on HY-WorldPlay-8B, as well as improving other metrics.
blocks.zh: 视频扩散变压器跨解码步骤再利用密钥-值(KV)缓存,这很快成为长视频生成的瓶颈. 我们发现,对时间上遥远的缓存向量进行量化会导致一个大范围且高度的量化错误,但KV-cache中附近的视频符号共享了每个频道的持续模式. 这些模式也因视频的不同而不同,激发了适应每个视频独特缓存的旋转. 我们提议了时间旋转量子化(TRQ),这种方法在量子化之前,在缓存中旋转帧. 对于每一块在时间上相邻的缓存向量,TRQ符合一个正向变换,该变换将块的每个通道表示一个接近跨通道常量的向量. 为了保持量化格式的轻量级,我们把这种旋转参数化为一棵2美元\times 2$ plamar旋转的树,每棵树只存储两个比特,然后是所有区块共享的固定的Hadamard变换. 旋转是合适的,没有梯度 或改变模型的重量, 我们证明一个简单的贪婪的适合 是全球最佳的, 对于我们的“平均膨胀”目标。 每个新视频的变换都是在线的, 我们释放了熔化的Triton内核, 使这个过程在推论上高效。 在2位精度和匹配压缩时,TRQ比最先进的方法QVG提高了V Bench主题的一致性,从LongCat-Video-13B上的90.38到92.02,以及HY-WorldPlay-8B上的86.33到87.61,并改进了其他度量衡.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) [ 19 ] have become the dominant architecture for video generation. They underpin proprietary systems such as Sora [ 3 ] and Movie Gen [ 20 ] , as well as open models including CogVideoX [ 27 ] , HunyuanVideo [ 11 ] , and Wan [ 24 ] , which synthesize high-fidelity videos from text or image prompts. To go beyond a few seconds of footage, toward minute-scale or interactive generation, recent work produces video autoregressively or by continuation, denoising one chunk at a time conditioned on previously generated content [ 4 , 28 , 10 , 21 , 5 , 17 ] . Like autoregressive language models, these systems store the keys and values of past frames in a KV-cache, so the history need not be recomputed at every denoising step.
blocks.zh: 传播变压器(DiTs)[19]已经成为视频生成的主导架构. 它们支撑着诸如Sora [3] 和 Movie Gen [20] 等专有系统,以及开放型号,包括CogVideoX [27],HunyuanVideo [11],和Wan [24],它们从文本或图像提示中合成高真实度视频. 为了超越几秒钟的镜头, 走向微量或互动的一代, 最近的工作会自动或继续制作视频, 和自动递归的语言模型一样,这些系统将过去帧的键和值存储在KV-cache中,因此历史不需要在每一个调值步骤上重算.

blocks.en: However, this computational saving from the KV-cache brings with it substantial memory requirements. Each frame contributes thousands of tokens, and the cache holds a key and a value vector per token, head, and layer. It therefore grows linearly with the generated history and can reach tens of gigabytes, more than commodity GPUs can hold [ 26 ] . Capping the cache, for example with a sliding window, shrinks the context the model can attend to and erodes long-range consistency of subjects, scene layout, and motion [ 26 ] . KV-cache quantization is mature for large language models [ 15 , 8 , 2 ] , but these methods were designed for the unique structure of LLM KV-caches and lose substantial accuracy when applied directly to video DiTs [ 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,从KV-cache中节省的计算,带来了大量的内存要求. 每个帧贡献了数千个令牌,缓存每个令牌,头,和图层都持有一个键和值矢量. 因此,它随着生成的历史线性增长,可以达到数十千兆字节,超过商品GPU可以持有[26]. 抓取缓存,例如用滑动窗口,缩小了模型能够处理的上下文,并侵蚀了主题,场景布局,和运动[26]的远程一致性. KV-cache定量化对于大型语言模型[15,8,2]是成熟的,但这些方法是为LLM KV-caches的独特结构设计的,在直接应用到视频DiTs[26]时会失去实质性的准确性.

blocks.en: Rotation transforms have proved remarkably effective for low-bit LLM quantization [ 2 , 14 , 22 , 16 ] . A central motivation for rotations in KV-cache quantization of LLMs is the empirically well-documented outlier structure along the channel dimension of the activations and KV-cache of LLMs. A small set of channels contain consistently large values across all tokens, forcing low-bit quantization to cover a wide range at the expense of resolution for smaller values. One intuition for why rotations are so effective in LLMs is that they take linear combinations of channels, ‘mixing’ the outlier channels with more benign channels and thus leading to much flatter distributions that are more friendly to quantization [ 2 ] .

blocks.en: We identify two unique properties of video diffusion KV-caches that motivate online temporal rotations (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们发现视频传播的两个独特的特性KV-caches可以激发在线时间旋转(图1).

blocks.en: (i) Temporal structure within a video. For a given video and channel of the cache, keys and values are highly correlated across nearby frames, with only localized changes as the scene evolves. We illustrate this structure in the first five panels of Figure 1 . This similarity, however, decays over time. Frames that are distant in time, such as frames 20 and 64 of the first video, can have substantially different values.
blocks.zh: (i) 录像中的时间结构。 对于缓存的给定视频和频道,密钥和值在附近框架之间高度相关,仅随着场景的演化而发生局部变化. 我们在图1的前五个小组中说明了这一结构。 然而,这种相似性随着时间推移而衰变。 在时间上遥远的帧,如第一部视频的帧20和64,其值可以有很大的不同.

blocks.en: (ii) Heterogeneous structure across videos. Although the cache is stable over adjacent frames within a video, the pattern itself differs from one video to the next. The final two panels of Figure 1 show frame 64 of two different videos at the same layer, head, and channel, and their key and value patterns are markedly different.
blocks.zh: (二) 跨视频的异质结构。 虽然缓存在视频内的相邻帧上是稳定的,但图案本身因视频的不同而不同. 图1的最后两个面板显示同一层,头,和频道两个不同视频的64帧,其键和值模式明显不同.

blocks.en: A generic channel rotation, such as the fixed random rotations used by QuaRot [ 2 ] , does not explicitly exploit either of these properties. A fixed rotation must simultaneously accommodate temporal and cross-channel variation with a single rotation. Moreover, because this temporal structure differs across videos, a rotation chosen before generation cannot adapt to the cache of the video actually being generated. Instead of applying a single rotation shared across all tokens, TRQ allows adjacent frames within one video to share a rotation adapted to the content they have in common. Specifically, we divide the cache at each patch into blocks of n B n_{B} consecutive latent frames and fit one orthogonal rotation 𝑹 B \bm{R}_{B} per block, which is applied to every frame in the block (Fig. 2 ). Fitting the rotation separately for each video and block allows it to track the scene as it evolves, while sharing the rotation within a block amortizes its storage cost over n B n_{B} cache vectors.

TRQ没有在所有符号上应用共享的单一旋转,而是允许一个视频中相邻的帧共享适合其共同内容的旋转. 具体地说,我们将每个补丁的缓存分成 n B n_{B} 连续的潜伏框架的块,并适合每个块一个正向旋转 R\bm{R}_{B},它应用到块中的每个框(图2). 将每个视频和块分开旋转,使得它能够随着演化而跟踪场景,同时在一个块内分享旋转,通过n B nQQB}缓存向量来分解其存储成本.

blocks.en: What should this shared rotation accomplish? An asymmetric quantizer stores a separate offset for each vector, allowing any component that is constant across channels to be represented without introducing additional quantization error. However, the temporal mean shared by nearby frames generally varies across channels, widening the range that must be quantized even when frame-specific deviations are small. We therefore seek a rotation R B R_{B} that transforms the block’s mean over time into a vector that is nearly constant across channels. This lets the quantizer’s offset to capture the shared component, leaving its limited quantization levels to represent the smaller frame-specific deviations more accurately (we make this more concrete in Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 这种共同轮换应实现什么目标? 一个不对称的量子存储每个向量的单独偏移,使得所有恒定跨通道的组件都能被表示而无需引入额外的量子化错误. 然而,附近帧共用的时间平均值一般因渠道而异,即使帧特定偏差较小,也扩大了必须量化的范围. 因此,我们寻求一个R B R → B → B → 轮回,将该区块的平均值随着时间推移而转变为一个几乎是源源不断的跨渠道的矢量。 这使得量子的抵消可以捕捉到共享组件,而其有限的量子化水平则能够更准确地反映较小的帧特定偏差(我们在第4节中使这一点更加具体 ) 。

blocks.en: A general d × d d\times d rotation per block would be prohibitively expensive for a KV-cache quantized to two bits per scalar. To reduce this overhead, we construct each rotation as a balanced tree of 2 × 2 2\times 2 planar rotations followed by a fixed Hadamard transform shared across all blocks. Each planar rotation mixes two channels, with its angle chosen from { 0 , π / 4 , π / 2 , 3 ​ π / 4 } \{0,\pi/4,\pi/2,3\pi/4\} . It is therefore stored with two bits and applied using only additions, subtractions, and a shared scaling. The tree uses d − 1 d-1 such rotations to progressively concentrate the energy of the block’s temporal mean into a single coordinate (Fig. 3 ), which the Hadamard transform then spreads evenly across all d d channels. For d = 128 d=128 , the adaptive rotation parameters require only 254 bits per block.
blocks.zh: 每个区块一般的 d × d d\ times d 旋转对一个 KV- cach 计算为每平方厘米 2 位将极为昂贵。 为了减少这种俯冲,我们构建每次旋转的平衡树,由2×2 2\时2平方厘米旋转,然后是所有区块共享的固定哈达马德变换. 每个平面旋转混合了两个频道,其角度选择从 {0,π / 4,π / 2, 3 π / 4}}\0,\pi/4,\pi/2,3\pi/4}. 因此,它用两个比特存储,并且只使用加法,减法和共享缩放法来应用. 该树使用d−1d-1这种旋转方式,逐渐将区块时间平均值的能量浓缩成一个单一坐标(图3),哈达马德变换后将均匀分布于所有dd通道. 对于d = 128 d = 128,适应性旋转参数只需要每块254位.

blocks.en: We fit the angles greedily, level by level in the tree, without gradients or changes to model weights. For a fixed tree (which refers to the chosen pairings of channels for the planar rotations), this procedure is globally optimal for our mean-flattening objective (Theorem 1 ). We also provide a custom Triton implementation of our scheme, which means that these rotations can be optimized online with almost no run-time overhead (Sec. 4.6 ). In experiments on LongCat-Video-13B, Self-Forcing-Wan-1.3B, and HY-WorldPlay-8B, TRQ outperforms the state-of-the-art video KV-cache quantization method QVG [ 26 ] at matched compression on all seven evaluated video fidelity and quality metrics for LongCat and Self-Forcing, and on six of seven for HY-WorldPlay (Sec. 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们贪婪地适应角度,在树上按层次排列,没有梯度或改变模型重量. 对于一棵固定树(指平面旋转通道的选定配对),这个程序对于我们的平均平面目标(定理1)来说是全球最佳的. 我们也提供特立顿定制的我们的计划执行,这意味着这些轮换可以在网上进行优化,几乎没有运行时间的间接费用(第4.6节). 在LongCat-Video-13B、Self-Forcing-Wan-1.3B和HY-WorldPlay-8B的实验中,TRQ在对LongCat和Self-Forcing的所有7项评价的视频忠诚度和质量度量进行相应压缩时,以及HY-WorldPlay(第5节)在6项7项的实验中,都超过了最先进的视频KV-cache量化法。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Diffusion transformers replace convolutional denoisers with transformer backbones in latent generative models [ 19 ] . LongCat-Video combines a diffusion-transformer architecture with video-continuation training and long-video inference [ 17 ] . HY-WorldPlay-8B is a streaming video diffusion world model that generates long-horizon video autoregressively in chunks, conditioned on user actions such as camera motion, and dynamically reconstitutes context from past frames to maintain long-term geometric consistency [ 23 ] . Our method targets the conditioning KV-cache used during such long-horizon generation. It does not alter the training objective, sampling schedule, or model parameters.
blocks.zh: 扩散变压器在潜伏的基因模型中用变压器骨干取代转动变压器 [19]. LongCat-Video结合传播-转换架构与视频连续培训和长视频推论[17]. HY-世界协会 Play-8B是一个流传的视频传播世界模型,它以块状自动生成长视距视频,以相机运动等用户动作为条件,并从过去帧状动态重组上下文,以保持长期的几何一致性[23]. 我们的方法针对的是这种长视距生成时使用的 KV-cache。 它不会改变培训目标、取样时间表或示范参数。

blocks.en: Q-Diffusion addresses post-training quantization of denoising networks through timestep-aware calibration and split shortcut quantization [ 12 ] . Those mechanisms concern quantizing the denoiser activations and network weights. The goal of this work is to instead quantize the KV-cache which is reused over a continuation’s denoising steps. The closest work is QVG [ 26 ] , which groups similar cache tokens, subtracts each group’s centroid and quantizes the remaining residuals in several stages. QVG explicitly represents cache patterns using centroids. Our method instead represents a local temporal mean implicitly through an adaptive orthogonal transform, motivated by the success of orthogonal transforms for the quantization of LLMs [ 14 , 2 , 16 ] .
blocks.zh: Q-Diffusion通过时间步解校准和分割快捷键量化处理去诺化网络的训练后量化[12]. 这些机制涉及将引爆装置和网络重量量化。 这项工作的目标是将KV-cache量化, 最接近的作品是QVG[26],它将相似的缓存符号分组,减去每个组的中间体,并分几个阶段对剩余部分进行定量. QVG明确表示使用百分数的缓存模式. 相反,我们的方法通过适应性的正交变换,间接地代表了当地的时间含义,这种变换的动机是正交变换的成功,从而将有限责任公司量化[14、2、16]。

blocks.en: Early methods for KV-cache quantization in LLMs mainly exploit the distinct structure of keys and values. KIVI quantizes keys per channel and values per token [ 15 ] , and KVQuant finds that pre-RoPE keys are more friendly for quantization [ 8 ] . A second line of work rotates the cache before quantization so that outlier channels are spread across many coordinates. QuaRot uses orthogonal rotations to redistribute activation outliers while folding the inverse transform into the weights [ 2 ] , SpinQuant learns rotations using Cayley SGD [ 14 ] , and RotateKV applies them before RoPE and across grouped heads [ 22 ] . PolarQuant and TurboQuant use random rotations to make the coordinate distribution predictable enough for simple scalar or polar quantizers [ 7 , 29 ] . In all of these methods, the rotation is either fixed or calibrated once and shared across tokens, and it targets outliers within each vector. Our transform instead adapts to each temporal block and targets the mean shared by neighboring frames. Because these transforms vary across blocks, they cannot be absorbed into one global rotation, so we parameterize them in a much more light-weight fashion (Sec. 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: LLMs中KV-cache的早期量化方法主要利用密钥和值的不同结构. KIVI 将每个通道的密钥和每个令牌的值量化 [15],KVQuant 发现预 RoPE密钥更便于量化 [8]. 第二行工作在量化前旋转缓存,这样,越野通道就分布在许多坐标上. QuaRot使用正交旋转来重新分配激活输出器,同时折叠反向变换为权重[2],SpinQuant使用Cayley SGD[14]学习旋转,旋转KV在RoPE之前和跨组头应用[22]. 极地量子和涡轮量子使用随机旋转使坐标分布具有足够可预计性,用于简单的斯卡尔或极地量子[7,29]. 在所有这些方法中,旋转要么是固定的,要么是校准一次,然后在符号之间共享,它针对的是每个矢量内部的异常点. 我们的转变则适应每一个时区 并瞄准邻边框共用的平均值 因为这些变换因区块而异,它们不能被吸收到一个全球旋转中,所以我们以更轻的量子方式参数化它们(第4.2条)。

blocks.en:
To make the temporal mean

for every block. The key intuition here is that 𝑯 \bm{H} can flatten
a vector with mass
concentrated in its first coordinate, but not an arbitrary vector.
We explain this property and how it motivates our construction.

However, applying 𝑯 \bm{H} directly to an arbitrary mean vector
need not make it flatter. For example, it maps ( 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ) (3,4,5,6) to ( 9 , − 1 , − 2 , 0 ) (9,-1,-2,0) , increasing rather than reducing its range.

the spreading operation is independent of the block, so the

blocks.en: 4.6 Efficient Triton Kernel
blocks.zh: 4.6 高效的三角内核

blocks.en:
We implement our block-wise rotation scheme with specialized Triton kernels for CUDA GPUs. We fuse the rotation fitting operation for all tree levels into one kernel, and each forward
or inverse traversal loads a tile of channel vectors once and writes the result
after the final level. Independent temporal blocks and spatial sites run in
parallel, avoiding the repeated indexing operations and intermediate tensors
of a level-by-level implementation. These changes reduce kernel-launch and intermediate-memory overhead
without changing the quantization algorithm or stored representation. For timings against native PyTorch, see Section 7.3 of the appendix.

或反转负载一次通道矢量的瓦片并写入结果
在最后关卡之后 独立时间块和空间站点运行于
并行,避免重复的索引操作和中间伸角
逐级执行。 这些变化减少了内核发射和中间模具的间接费用

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en:
We introduced TRQ a 2-bit KV-cache
quantization method for video diffusion transformers. TRQ exploits the
observation that adjacent frames in a video cache share a slowly varying
per-channel mean. It fits a separate rotation to each temporal block that
flattens this mean, so the quantizer’s offset can absorb the shared component.
Each rotation is a tree of 2 × 2 2\times 2 planar rotations with two-bit angles,
followed by a fixed Hadamard transform. Across
three video diffusion transformers, TRQ substantially improves fidelity over QVG and other KV-cache compression baselines at similar
compression levels.
TRQ benefits from exploiting temporal redundancy. This leaves open how best to
handle content where that redundancy is weaker, such as fast motion or scene
cuts. Block lengths that adapt to scene dynamics are a natural way to address
this. Moreover, TRQ and centroid-based methods such as QVG exploit
complementary structure, and combining the two could lead to gains over either alone. Finally, the online rotation fitting explored in TRQ has not been done to our knowledge for other model families and modalities, and is a promising avenue for future work.
